conflicts.resolution: Publish the cross-checked 10× / 100× multipliers, but direct readers to the live pet card for the precise cash and movement fields.
Publish only the official visible event title and displayed start; do not invent an end time or claim unobserved mechanics.
Publish Glass Egg as a reported route from independent guides, not as a guaranteed outcome or fixed rate.
